sources.title: GitHub - mabosaimi/hadhari
sources.snippet: Hadhari (حذارِ) is a machine learning model designed to detect spam messages in Arabic text. The name Hadhari comes from the Arabic word "حذارِ", meaning "beware" or "watch out". It was inspired by a professor who is known for saying this phrase so often in his AI class that it became his catch-phrase.
